title: Jimmy Cox and his songs
summary: They discuss Cox as a songwriter, whose songs Sarah Martin sang.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Yeah, and this little fellow named Memphis. Memphis. And they had, what do you name, I ever wrote that song, Sarah Martin Sings. Cox, Jimmy Cox.
Well, nah, that's what I heard. And I heard some people say he wouldn't, but I heard he was from here.
He wrote some good numbers. You know, he wrote Nobody Knows You When You're Dying in the House.
Yeah, he wrote Last Go Round Blues.
Yeah, a whole lot of things like that he wrote.
Yeah, he wrote some. And he had a good voice too.
I never heard him on a record.
Boy, he had a good voice. Yeah, I don't believe he made a record, did he?

Last Go Round he wrote On His Dying Bed.
He wrote Last Go Round On His Dying Bed.
